source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended August 2, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of August 28, 2026, there were 4,773,629,865 shares of our common stock outstanding.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as AVGO. The 10-Q cover for the quarter ended August 2, 2026 (filed September 10, 2026) is the latest count; the FY2026 10-K (year ended about November 1, 2026) had not been filed by November 24, 2026. Preferred stock is authorized but none is issued.
